install_tell: Enterprise-only self-hosted; Docker Compose or Kubernetes Helm chart; Python Flask backend + PostgreSQL 15 + Redis/Valkey 8.1.0
misconfig_patterns: PROMPTLAYER_API_KEY committed to source repos or client-side JavaScript
BETTER_AUTH_SECRET left as default 'change-me-in-production' in self-hosted deployments
API key passed as plain request body parameter (not header) in legacy REST calls
Self-hosted deployment without TLS exposes full prompt/response log stream in cleartext

active_probe.false_positive_check: Must see 'request_id' in JSON response body — generic 400/401 without PromptLayer markers is not confirmation

deployment_tells: HTTP title contains 'PromptLayer' on port 3000 or 443
REST API base at /rest/ with JSON responses containing 'request_id' field
Backend is Python Flask (server header: Werkzeug or gunicorn)
Enterprise-only: public SaaS at api.promptlayer.com; self-hosted requires license
pivot_paths: PROMPTLAYER_API_KEY -> GET /rest/get-prompt-template returns full prompt versions and templates
Track-request log stream -> full prompt+completion history with timestamps and model metadata
BETTER_AUTH_SECRET default -> forged session tokens in self-hosted deployments
Celery/Redis queue exposed -> task injection into background worker pipeline
